# Lakeland Surveying

> Licensed New Jersey land surveying firm (est. 1972) based in Lavallette, Ocean County, NJ. Serves the Jersey Shore and South Jersey across nine counties: Ocean, Monmouth, Atlantic, Cape May, Burlington, Camden, Gloucester, Salem, and Cumberland. Specializes in FEMA flood elevation certificates for coastal and barrier-island properties, plus boundary, topographic, title/ALTA, construction stakeout, and condominium surveys.

Lakeland Surveying, Inc. is a New Jersey Professional Land Surveyor (PLS) firm founded in 1972 and located at 1501 Grand Central Avenue, Lavallette, NJ 08735. Its core specialty is FEMA Elevation Certificates and flood-zone work (AE and VE zones, LOMA and LOMR-F applications, NAVD 88 datum) for shore and barrier-island properties in Ocean, Monmouth, Atlantic, and Cape May counties.

## Services

- [Flood Elevation Certificates](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/flood-elevation-certificates.html): FEMA Elevation Certificates for flood insurance rating, LOMA/LOMR-F support, AE and VE zone determinations, NAVD 88 datum.
- [Boundary Surveys](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/boundary-surveys.html): Property line location for closings, disputes, fences, and permits.
- [Topographic Surveys](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/topographic-surveys.html): Site elevations and contours for design and drainage.
- [Title & ALTA Surveys](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/title-surveys.html): ALTA/NSPS and title surveys for closings, refinancing, and lender requirements.
- [Construction Stakeout](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/construction-stakeout.html): Field layout for builders and contractors.
- [Condominium Surveys](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/condominium-surveys.html): Master deed and unit certification surveys.
- [All Services](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/): Overview of every survey type offered.

## Primary Service Areas

- [Lavallette, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/lavallette.html): Home office; barrier island flood elevation and boundary work.
- [Toms River, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/toms-river.html): Largest Ocean County market; full survey services.
- [Seaside Heights, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/seaside-heights.html): Barrier island elevation certificates and boundary surveys.
- [Seaside Park, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/seaside-park.html): Barrier island flood zone and boundary work.
- [Ortley Beach, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/ortley-beach.html): Post-storm elevation certificates and rebuild surveys.
- [Mantoloking, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/mantoloking.html): VE zone coastal surveying.
- [Bay Head, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/bay-head.html): Coastal boundary and elevation surveys.
- [Point Pleasant Beach, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/point-pleasant-beach.html): Shore boundary, elevation, and title surveys.
- [Brick, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/brick.html): Barnegat Bay waterfront and inland surveying.
- [Long Beach Island, NJ](https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/long-beach-island.html): LBI-wide flood elevation certificates and boundary surveys.
